What's this hack? This is only used in editor code, where better solutions exist (you could use a singleton or whatever).
Why does this need a new Callable type?

The old approach using `CONNECT_ONE_SHOT | CONNECT_REFERENCE_COUNTED` is buggy. It fails to invoke distinct `p_callable` instances separately. Instead, only the very first `p_callable` gets executed, because all `p_callable`s are bound to the same Callable `Control::call_on_all_layout_pending_finished`.
This might be an inherent issue with `CONNECT_REFERENCE_COUNTED`. Refer to: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112682#issuecomment-4366372526
That’s why I adopted a new Callable type for this case. I’d be glad to see any better alternative solution if you have one.

Sounds like a case for #112682
